notes: The Studio gets its ARRANGE view — a real song timeline, powered by OpenStudio's beat-domain transport (now fully merged into the soundLAB engine, one engine for everything). Every track is a lane: tap to place clips of its pattern, sampler lanes place the actual AUDIO with its waveform drawn on the clip. Drag clips along the timeline and between lanes, shift-tap to multi-select, right-click or Delete to remove. Tap the ruler to jump the playhead, drag it to draw a LOOP region. Lane headers carry mute/solo/volume and LIVE METERS. Snap (bar/beat/quarter/off), zoom, follow-playhead auto-scroll, Space to play/stop, and Export song renders the whole arrangement to WAV. Built for smoothness: the playhead is a single transform on the compositor, waveforms draw once, and 20 tracks scroll at full frame rate mid-playback.
